title: AgentOffer Offer Schema v1.0
description: Adopted Offer Schema v1.0 for intent-matched conversational recommendations.

offer_id.description: AON-issued, globally unique inventory identity for the logical Offer. It remains stable across returned instances and must never contain a Partner source identifier, row id, or request correlation id.

offer_instance_id.description: AON-issued identity for this dispatch of the Offer. Consumers propagate it unchanged through click and conversion attribution; a later dispatch of the same offer_id receives a different value.

version.description: Offer document-model lineage. It identifies the Offer payload model and does not select the transport protocol version.

content_language.description: Language tag for user-facing Offer text under the stable-v1.0 BCP-47 profile: a two- or three-letter ASCII primary language subtag with optional extlang, script, region, variant, extension, and private-use subtags. This profile validates syntax, not IANA registry membership. It does not express targeting eligibility or select the protocol version.

offer_info.description: User-facing descriptive, category, commercial, and availability information for the Offer.

title.description: Short user-facing name used to identify the Offer in a result, card, or other presentation.

offer_type.description: High-level class of what is offered. It supports presentation and product understanding; it is not the executable consumer action.

category.description: Primary AON Taxonomy v1 classification for the Offer.

secondary_category_ids.description: Optional additional AON Taxonomy v1 classifications. When present the array is non-empty; entries add descriptive coverage and must remain distinct from the primary category and from one another under semantic validation.

description.description: User-facing explanation of what the Offer provides. It is Offer content, not an AON ranking explanation.

tags.description: Optional non-empty set of short descriptive labels for presentation or filtering. Tags do not replace canonical taxonomy classification or targeting rules.

rating.description: Optional user-visible rating summary supplied with the Offer. It is descriptive content and not an AON endorsement.

properties.description: Optional non-empty, bounded list of structured user-facing facts, such as duration, plan tier, or included features.

recommendation_reason.description: Optional non-empty static Partner- or provider-authored Offer copy. It may be displayed to the user, but is not a per-request AON match explanation and is unaffected by thinking_mode.

commercial.description: Optional public commercial presentation, including a displayed price and fulfillment note. It excludes internal commission, settlement, and eligibility policy.

start_at.description: Optional start of the user-visible Offer availability window.

expire_at.description: Optional end of the user-visible Offer availability window. When both availability bounds are supplied, it must not precede start_at.

entity.description: Public identity of the party responsible for the Offer.

id.description: Stable identifier for the merchant, brand, provider, publisher, or other party responsible for the Offer. It is not an Offer identifier.

name.description: User-facing name of the entity responsible for the Offer.

type.description: Role of the entity in relation to the Offer.

description.description: Optional non-empty user-facing description of the responsible entity.

website.description: Optional public HTTPS website for the responsible entity. It is identity metadata, not the action destination, and must not contain URI userinfo.

logo.description: Optional public logo for the responsible entity. It is an absolute HTTPS resource URI and must not contain URI userinfo.

listing_source.description: Optional provenance for the external platform or site where listing information was observed.

kind.description: Classification of the external place where user-facing listing information was observed.

name.description: User-facing name of the observed platform or site. It remains distinct from entity.name.

observed_at.description: UTC timestamp for when the listing information was observed. It is provenance metadata, not the Offer availability window.

logo.description: Optional explicit logo of the observed platform or site. It is an absolute HTTPS resource URI without userinfo and must not be inferred from entity, action, or material fields.

action.description: Executable user-choice destination associated with the Offer.

type.description: Technical form of the executable action destination.

name.description: Optional non-empty concise call-to-action label for the user.

consumer_action.description: User-intent classification for the action. It describes what the user is invited to do and is distinct from a conversion Goal event.

description.description: Optional non-empty user-facing explanation of what invoking the action does.

destination_types.description: Optional non-empty declaration of destination surfaces supported by the action.

payload.description: Executable action parameters. Stable v1.0 defines one safe absolute URI destination.

url.description: Safe absolute URI invoked when the user chooses the action. javascript, data, vbscript, and file schemes are forbidden; open_url additionally requires HTTPS.

type.description: Conditional discriminator selecting the HTTPS-only open_url branch.

payload.description: Action payload constrained by the selected open_url branch.

url.description: Absolute HTTPS destination required when action.type is open_url.

material.description: Optional non-empty list of user-facing creative assets for presenting the Offer.

claims.description: Optional non-empty, bounded list of source-provided statements about the Offer. They are not AON endorsements.

match_reason.description: AON-authored, per-request user-facing explanation of why this Offer matches the current intent. It is omitted when response_options.thinking_mode is false and must not expose private reasoning or ranking data.

goals.description: Public conversion event declarations and their associated public pricing model.

categoryId.description: Canonical AON Taxonomy v1 category identifier.

id.description: Canonical AON Taxonomy v1 category identifier.

rating.description: User-visible rating summary that always declares a rating value.

value.description: Rating value on the declared five-point scale.

count.description: Positive number of observations represented by the rating when supplied. Omit count when no observation count is available.

source.description: Optional name of the source that supplied the rating.

type.description: Stable machine-readable key for the displayed fact.

unit.description: Optional non-empty unit that qualifies the displayed value.

display_pattern.description: Optional non-empty presentation template for this fact. Only same-item tokens ${type}, ${value}, and ${unit} are allowed; the template does not change the underlying value.

price.description: Optional displayed price. It is public Offer content, not Goal commission or final settlement data.

amount.description: Canonical decimal string for the displayed price amount.

currency.description: Uppercase three-letter currency code for the displayed price.

unit.description: Unit or billing period to which the displayed price applies.

fulfillment_note.description: Optional short user-facing note about fulfillment or a material price condition.

material.description: One user-facing creative asset retrieved from a trusted transport resource.

url.description: Absolute HTTPS URI for retrieving the creative asset; URI userinfo is forbidden.

tag.description: Optional producer-supplied label for the creative asset. It must not be treated as targeting or eligibility data.

dimensions.description: Optional producer-declared dimensions or aspect descriptor for rendering.

alt_text.description: Optional accessibility text describing the creative asset.

claim.description: One bounded source-provided statement about the Offer.

kind.description: Classification of the statement so consumers can present it with appropriate context.

text.description: User-facing text of the statement. It remains source-provided content, not an AON endorsement.

goal.description: Public declaration of a billable conversion event and the gross Partner-to-AON commission basis. It is not the user-visible Offer price or a final settlement record.

event.description: Canonical conversion event name for this Goal; events are unique within one Offer.

pricing.description: Gross commission the Partner declares payable to AON for an approved, attributed occurrence of this Goal, before AON fees, developer share, refunds, holds, disputes, or adjustments.

oneOf.description: Fixed Partner-to-AON commission for each approved occurrence of the Goal event.

model.description: Cost per action: a fixed gross commission per approved, attributed Goal event.

amount.description: Strictly positive canonical decimal amount of gross Partner-to-AON commission for one approved Goal event.

currency.description: Uppercase three-letter currency code for the CPA commission amount.

oneOf.description: Percentage Partner-to-AON commission applied to the gross conversion amount reported for an approved sale.

model.description: Cost per sale: a percentage of the approved conversion's gross reported amount.

rate.description: Strictly positive canonical percentage rate, greater than zero and no greater than 100, applied to the gross conversion amount in its reported currency.

description.description: Optional non-empty user-facing explanation of what user outcome constitutes the Goal; it does not change attribution or payment terms.
